gemini.title: Administrative Counties Boundary
gemini.abstract: Administrative Counties Boundary is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It represents administrative counties boundary features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
